title: Autonomous bounded BFS crawl: the tool explores a product on its own

description: stages/explore.py + explore_node.py crawl a project breadth-first within bounds that can each end the crawl and name themselves, refusing anything explore_safety denies. Screen identity is structural (templated URL + a signature of non-row controls), so two list rows are one screen while a same-URL SPA state with new controls is a different one. description: Any teaching material — pasted text, a document, an audio file, an .eml/.mbox email with attachments, or a Google Drive folder — registers as a Source on the existing Source model + sources.jsonl, deduped by sha256, provenance-tracked (children link to their parent), and degrading honestly (an unreadable input becomes a Source with extraction_error, never silent-empty). title: Resumable learn-or-explore orchestrator with durable per-stage checkpoints
reason: Closes T-163 (D-036), the first unit of the reusable-platform's systematic-exploration milestone (M8), promoting DISCOVER + MODEL to named stages. Built under Umesh's standing 'proceed aage kar jo features banane hain' mandate; dual independent checker-PASS (OR1-OR6, OR3 verified end-to-end on both sides). PREFILLED -- Umesh to confirm or edit.
description: One driver (stages/orchestrate.py::run_or_resume) runs the stage pipeline as a resumable run: it picks the entry path once (teaching Sources -> learn/INGEST; credentials only -> explore/DISCOVER) and records the reason, checkpoints each stage in a RunState ledger keyed by run_id, and resumes after a crash by re-entering the first stage whose artifact is missing -- no LangGraph or database, the existing per-stage filestore artifacts ARE the durable checkpoints. Both entry paths propose their FlowSpec into a DRAFT through the existing merge_flowspec, which never rewrites a human-reviewed screen and re-arms the review gate, so an orchestrated run can never silently overwrite APPROVED truth.

title: Durable cross-run Portal Persona with change detection and dated history
reason: Closes T-164 (D-038): AutoTester keeps what it learned about a portal across runs instead of relearning it every crawl, which the persona-seeded incremental crawl and change tracking in Umesh's 2026-09-23 direction build on. Single independent checker-PASS, PP1-PP6 each falsified in a throwaway copy. PREFILLED -- Umesh to confirm or edit.
description: Promotes the per-crawl screen graph and knowledge page into a durable, versioned PortalPersona artifact per project (schema/portal_persona.py) built by stages/portal_persona.py::build_portal_persona. Each rebuild diffs against the previous persona, records what changed with a dated history, and regenerates a human-readable knowledge view (stages/portal_persona_view.py); an identical rebuild records no change. It is an artifact plus a stage, not a new pipeline stage or datastore (D-038).

title: First-party API/network assertions during crawl and run
reason: Closes T-170 (D-040 split from T-165, built first because it needs no traversal work): a product's own 500s and failed calls become test evidence instead of passing silently behind a screen that looks fine. Single independent checker-PASS, NA1-NA6 each falsified in a throwaway copy. PREFILLED -- Umesh to confirm or edit.
description: While a crawl or a test run drives the browser, AutoTester records every first-party API response (method, URL, status) as NETWORK evidence through the one existing response listener, scrubbing secrets from URLs before anything is stored; third-party calls are excluded. A test can now declare expected network calls and get a real met/unmet result, and crawl network evidence persists per crawl (crawl/<id>/network.jsonl). Capture only observes -- the grader still owns every verdict.
